name: Shrewd Negotiation — Permanent A is an artifact you control, B an artifact or creature you don't control
notes: "Exchange control of target artifact you control and target artifact or creature you don't control." (2026-10-18.) Both targets were held to A's "artifact", so B listed only the opponent's Mind Stone. A lists Sol Ring (not Hill Giant); B lists Grizzly Bears and Mind Stone, not the opponent's Island. The pair Sol Ring / Island set anyway is refused by the engine.
